chatEngine.paletteMissing: I can't reach the ActionType palette on this deployment, so I have no building blocks to offer. The workflow authoring routes are not wired here.
chatEngine.welcome:
Let's design a workflow together. I'll ask a few questions, show the exact YAML, and validate it before anything is saved.

Start with **what the workflow should do**: pick an action below or search the full ActionType palette. You can also describe the goal in your own words - I keep it as the workflow description, while actions and triggers are always chosen explicitly.

Workflows you can build, for example:
- *When cost spikes, right-size the resource and post a summary.*
- *Every week, rehearse a DR failover.*
- *When a resource drifts, open a remediation pull request.*
chatEngine.goalRecorded: I kept that as the workflow description.
chatEngine.actionRetry: I couldn't map that to an action - typed text doesn't select an ActionType here. Pick one below or search the full palette.
chatEngine.askAction: First, **what should the workflow do?** Pick an action below or search the full ActionType palette.
chatEngine.triggerRetry: I couldn't read a trigger from that - choose one of these.
chatEngine.askTrigger: **When should it run?** Choose the signal that starts it, or a schedule.
chatEngine.confirmPlan: Please confirm this trigger and ordered action chain before I continue.
chatEngine.offerExtra: Want to **add another step** - for example a notification or a follow-up remediation? Pick one below, search the palette, or keep it as-is.
chatEngine.confirmSafety: Safety review: this draft stays in **shadow** mode, has no automatic failure fallback, and requires {days} days, {samples} samples, {accuracy} accuracy, and at most {escapes} policy escapes before promotion. A failed step stops the run. Keep these safeguards, or type what this workflow must never do to record an anti-scope boundary.
chatEngine.confirmName: Almost done. I'll call it `{name}`. Keep that name, or type a different one.
chatEngine.ready: Here's the workflow from our conversation, with its YAML, flow, and structural validation below. Nothing is created until you save a private draft; publishing goes through catalog review.
chatEngine.cloned: I copied `{source}` into a new draft named `{name}`. It stays in shadow mode and is validated again below before you can save it. Edit the draft, or refine it with the options below.
chatEngine.truncatedWarning: More than three distinct actions matched; review and add the omitted steps explicitly.
